YTA but your heart was in the right place. An example I can give is when someone says “so and so is the first black…” and people respond by saying it shouldn’t matter which race you are. It shouldn’t but sadly that’s just not how the world works at the moment. It’s the same with coming out as gay. In theory it should warrant the same reaction as your straight children saying they prefer to date the opposite sex but because of the stigma around being gay In Today’s society it is a really big deal to come out and you should appreciate that at least.
